system.description:
[Trigger: Instant] Only activates if you have the [Nature] or [Beast] tag. Deals 10 points of direct damage to a single target within 4Sq. 2 times per scenario. A staff that lets its wielder "load" plant-type spells, adjusting when a single pre-cast spell takes effect or time-shifting its reuse restriction. It could be called the Druid's basic equipment. Higher-level versions support more spells and more loads.

Seed of Eternal Sleep [Core Material] (100G) + Bamboo Staff (180G) ×2 + [Magic Catalyst 7] (60G) ×4 + Crafting Cost (300G)
